notes.title: Artbook and OST now available!
notes.content:
Hello! If you already bought the game you should receive a new UPDATE! 

This one includes:
[h1]Original Soundtrack and the Artbook from Samsa![/h1]
You will be able to listen the music and see the beautiful art, if you look inside the installation folder, there should be two new features:

[h1]- Samsa OST
- The Art of Samsa[/h1]

For new purchases, the Art and OST will be downloaded automatically.
Hope you enjoy it!
